name: io.github.Aadeshjain25/synapse
title: Synapse
description: Codebase memory for AI coding agents: files, lines, callers and tests for any public GitHub repo.

tools.name: plan_change
tools.description: Call ONCE at the start of a coding task. A complete brief: files and line ranges to change, the key functions in full with their callers, the existing pattern to follow, decisions not to break and the only tests to run. From the code graph, not guesses.

task.description: What you are about to do, in plain words (e.g. "add rate limiting to the refresh token endpoint").

repository.description: Public GitHub repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "pallets/flask") or its github.com URL.

paths.description: Files or folders you already know are involved.

detail.description: map: a short edit map (files, line ranges, pattern, unit tests); full: also the key functions in full. Default: map for code changes, full for plans and questions.

targets.description: Real names in this repo the task is about (functions, classes, constants, files), from the vocabulary in the server instructions, e.g. ["AuthController.refresh"].

terms.description: Words this codebase would use for the task, e.g. ["throttle"] for "rate limiting", ["revoke", "grant"] for "disconnect apps".

tools.name: read_code
tools.description: Read code without opening whole files. With `symbol`: just that function, method or class (numbered lines). Without: the file's outline (every declaration with its signature and line range). Use instead of reading a full file.

symbol.description: Function, method or class name, e.g. "refresh" or "AuthController.refresh".

repository.description: Public GitHub repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "pallets/flask") or its github.com URL.

tools.name: why
tools.description: Reasons behind a file or line: decisions from PRs, reviews and reverts, the commit that last changed the line (with its message), the function there and who knows the code. Use before changing or deleting code that looks odd.

repository.description: Public GitHub repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "pallets/flask") or its github.com URL.

tools.name: blast_radius
tools.description: Every call site of a file or one of its functions, with the calling line of code, plus importers and tests. Use before changing a signature or deleting code.

symbol.description: Optional function/class/method name in that file.

repository.description: Public GitHub repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "pallets/flask") or its github.com URL.

tools.name: find_existing
tools.description: Search existing functions, classes and methods by what they do (e.g. "format currency"). Use before writing a new helper.

repository.description: Public GitHub repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "pallets/flask") or its github.com URL.

tools.name: tests_for
tools.description: The test files that cover the given files (direct importers, same-name tests, and tests one import away), so you run only those instead of the whole suite.

repository.description: Public GitHub repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "pallets/flask") or its github.com URL.

tools.name: repo_map
tools.description: One screen on an unfamiliar repo: main areas with their most used code, entry points, API routes and pages, where tests live, and the stack. Call once instead of exploring folders.

repository.description: Public GitHub repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "pallets/flask") or its github.com URL.
